name: South Indian Bank Ltd
title: South Indian Bank Ltd - 532218 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Bank posted record FY26 profit of INR1,455 crore (+12%) with GNPA down to 1.43% and Q4 credit cost of 3bp, but management flags credit cost troughed and guides FY27 loan growth of 15-16%.

triggers.label: FY27 loan growth 15-16%
triggers.quote: we are still aiming to get between 15% and 16%

triggers.label: NIM up 9bp in Q4
triggers.quote: over the last two quarters our NIMs have improved by about 15 basis points, I mean six basis points in Q3 and nine basis points in Q4

triggers.label: Credit cost trough, expected to rise
triggers.quote: I think if anything, both slippages and credit cost should trend upwards

triggers.label: Treasury income nil in Q4 vs INR77 crore Q3
triggers.quote: in Q3, we had an income of around INR77 crores, so that is almost nil in Q4

guidance.quote: we are still aiming to get between 15% and 16%
the corporate goes down from 38 to 33

red_flags.label: Gold loan price-risk exposure
red_flags.quote: if the price of gold were to dip by more than that, then there will be some incremental hit to the bank

red_flags.label: CEO succession pending
red_flags.quote: my term ends on the 30th of September

red_flags.label: Opex growth to resume
red_flags.quote: expenses cannot be kept at this level indefinitely

evasions.quote: The exact number as to what proportion of our NRI book is West Asia and what is not is not available with me right now
